prompt:
Create a NEW transparent raster icon sheet for a children's educational game. Two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Reference 2, the small greenhouse icon, is the primary reference: match its THIN dark navy outlines, simple glossy cel shading, rounded storybook game asset rendering and cream/sky-blue palette. Reference 1 robot is secondary for friendly forms only. Do not draw either reference object or any lettering.

OUTPUT: landscape 3:1 aspect ratio, ideally 1536x512. ONE ROW of THREE equal square cells. Three distinct icon groups centered at 1/6, 1/2, 5/6 of canvas width, all vertically centered. Each complete group occupies about 75% of its square cell in its longest dimension. Equal visual scale, gentle 3/4 front view showing front and right side, generous margins. No grid lines, labels, cell borders or tiles. Every group fully visible and contained in its cell.
BACKGROUND: real fully transparent alpha, empty space around objects; no backdrop, shadow on floor, glow, halo or vignette.
RENDERING: fine clean even dark-navy outlines matching reference greenhouse, approximately 2px at this size, never thick sticker outlines. Clean solid color fills: one base color, one discrete soft shadow tone and one small highlight per material. Gloss from a small solid highlight, no gradients, grain, texture, patchiness or washed-out surfaces. Simple instantly recognizable forms, few small details.
PALETTE: white or warm cream main bodies, accents teal, coral, sunny yellow, sky blue. Green sprouts/indicator lights and a little brown soil inside pot are requested natural-color exceptions. No text, letters, numbers, AI, logos or brands anywhere.

LEFT CELL — SMART WATERING:
A cream flower pot holding exactly TWO small green sprouts. A slender teal irrigation pipe beside the pot bends over it with a downturned drip nozzle. Exactly ONE sky-blue water drop falling from nozzle onto sprouts. A small sensor stick is inserted into soil beside sprouts, with a tiny green indicator light. Brown soil visible ONLY within the pot opening, no dirt outside the pot. Pipe, pot, sprouts, drop and sensor make one compact connected visual group. No watering can. Clear separation of water drop and sprout leaves.

MIDDLE CELL — PERFORMANCE INTERPRETER:
A miniature theater stage with coral-red curtains drawn OPEN to both sides, revealing an empty cream stage. Simple cream frame and shallow stage base, gentle 3/4 view. In FRONT of the stage, a prominent white wireless in-ear earpiece with a TEAL silicone tip, tilted so recognizably an earbud. One small cream speech bubble floating just above the earpiece contains only a simple teal globe pictogram. Keep stage and earpiece a single balanced compact group. Theater curtains must be unmistakable, not a spotlight. No people, no microphones, no signs or writing.

RIGHT CELL — SMART AIR PURIFIER:
A tall rounded cream freestanding air purifier with a large round fan GRILLE clearly visible on its FRONT. Simple circular radial grille with just a few neat spokes/slats and a restrained sky-blue inner fan. A tiny GREEN indicator light on the front. Two or three soft sky-blue curved AIR SWIRL LINES rise from the top; these are crisp thin curved graphic strokes, not hazy clouds or gradients. Airflow lines remain within the group bounds. No leaf icon, no extra screen or labels.

Exactly three icon groups across one row, same thin line weight, same scale and rendering as greenhouse reference, fully transparent background.
